points.description: States that N1 was likely never a leader in any of the three terms (N5 is not the answer).

Justifies by showing the other nodes can account for the leaders of the terms: N4 (a, b, c) could be the term 1 leader, N3 (…, r, s) the term 2 leader, and N2 (…, x, y, z) the term 3 leader. Equivalent reasoning, e.g. each of these logs holds the full set of entries of that term, earns the mark.
points.partial_credit: Half if only two of the three term leaders are correctly identified/justified.
